_readme: Experiences listed in the VR Lab (vr.html), rendered by assets/js/pages/vr-lab.js.
exclusive  true = built for headsets first; the flat page is a preview
comfort    how you move: keep teleport/seated experiences, no smooth motion
related    site-relative lesson links shown on the card
New immersive pages should use assets/js/xr-kit.mjs (Enter VR button, laser pointers,
teleport, snap turn, text panels) and keep a flat HTML version of the same content.

experiences.title: Solar System Walk
experiences.summary: Stand beside the Sun, then teleport out past every planet. Point at one to see its size, its day and year, and how long sunlight takes to reach it.

experiences.title: Student Showcase Hall
experiences.summary: Every project in the class showcase, hung on the walls of a round gallery. Point at a frame to read about it, then open it right from the headset.

experiences.title: Virtual Reality Museum
experiences.summary: Walk among 3D models and artifacts, including ones uploaded by the class. Works on a screen; press Enter VR in a headset.

related.title: Add a model to the museum

experiences.title: Build Your Own VR Gallery
experiences.summary: The lesson behind these rooms: ask the browser for a headset with WebXR, and keep a flat page that works for everyone else.
